decisions.reason: As a newly launched flagship reusable crate aligned with the firm's sustainability and agriculture focus, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
This foldable large container line fits the firm's core returnable-packaging business and its dedicated web presence suggests ongoing commercial commitment.
A stackable plastic crate line is close to the firm's standard offering and should remain on the market unless early demand is clearly weak.
The medium-duty rackable pallet line supports the firm's broad reusable logistics portfolio, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.
Although somewhat more specialized, the spill-retention pallet line still leverages the firm's pallet expertise and dedicated marketing indicates intended continuity.
This plastic pallet variant with load retainers complements the established pallet range and is likely to be retained as a niche offering rather than dropped immediately.
